short_bio: American YouTuber, podcaster and founder of Chamberlain Coffee.
biography:
Emma Chamberlain was born in San Mateo County, California, and grew up in the Bay Area. She started posting videos on YouTube in 2016, known for their quick jump-cut editing.

In 2019 she launched the podcast Anything Goes and founded Chamberlain Coffee, which began selling coffee that year.

She won the 2018 Streamy Award for Breakout Creator, and Time named her one of the most influential teens of 2019.
